description: Novated lease savings (Australia) [AU]. Estimates the yearly saving from a novated lease for 2026-27: GST credits, the pre-tax deduction, tax saved and the employee contribution method (20% statutory formula), including the electric car FBT exemption. Doesn't apply the proposed EV changes from 1 April 2027, the operating cost method, balloon payments, fees or super effects.

annualCosts.description: Total yearly lease and running costs (finance, fuel or charging, insurance, rego, servicing, tyres), GST-inclusive

baseValue.description: Car base value: GST-inclusive cost price plus delivery and accessories, excluding registration and stamp duty

salary.description: Gross annual salary before the lease

vehicle.description: electric = battery electric or hydrogen; plug-in hybrids no longer qualify for the exemption

name: au_novated_lease
